crossRefs.note: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
translations.bsb: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.
translations.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
translations.asv: Now Jesus had spoken of his death: but they thought that he spake of taking rest in sleep.
